title: Anomaly Thread Annotator: compact synthesis UI for correlating failed requests
creator: Maya Chen
description: Design a compact, read-friendly UI panel that surfaces correlated failed requests as an "annotated thread". The Annotator groups related failures (same error class, identical payload diffs, or retry patterns) into a single timeline with automatic root-cause snippets, suggested next steps for engineers, and links to full payload/trace inspectors. This is intended for SREs and product engineers who need fast, high-confidence triage without opening multiple full request pages.
design_notes: We iterate on three layout variants: 1) Compact stack with expandable snippets, 2) Spatial swimlane with causal arrows, 3) Card-grid with risk scores. Current prototype favors Compact stack for density and faster scanning. Key signals used to auto-group: error signature hash, top-3 stack frames, request path, KV-cache hit/miss tags, and immediate prior-response diffs. We will compute a lightweight agreement score (0-1) to show confidence of grouping. Trade-offs: density vs. contextual depth — we’ll include a lightweight preview and a single-click jump to the full request inspector rather than inline expansion of large payloads to avoid network/CPU spikes in Console. Consider accessibility: keyboard nav between thread items and screen-reader friendly summaries.
acceptance_criteria: Annotated thread groups failures with >=75% manual-agreement on 200-sample dataset
Each thread shows a 1-2 sentence autogenerated root-cause snippet and a confidence score
One-click jump opens full request inspector centred on the selected event
UI renders 100 threads in under 1.5s on standard Console performance test
Keyboard navigation and SR-friendly summaries implemented
